Charlie starts with 10 stickers. He buys 21, bringing his total to 10 + 21 = 31. He receives 23 for his birthday, so now he has 31 + 23 = 54. After giving 9 to his sister, he has 54 - 9 = 45. Finally, he uses 28 to decorate a greeting card, leaving him with 45 - 28 = 17 stickers.

Answer: 17
